lines.zh: 土豆奶酪饺子卖光了。有肉馅的。

lines.pl: Nie ma ruskich. Polecam pierogi z kapustą.
lines.en: No ruskie pierogi left. I recommend cabbage pierogi.
lines.zh: 没有土豆奶酪饺子了。我推荐酸菜馅饺子。

beats.goal: Ask about drink and extra side

lines.en: With that, compote or tea?
lines.zh: 配果脯水还是茶？

lines.pl: Coś do picia? Jest świeży kompot.
lines.en: Something to drink? There is fresh compote.
lines.zh: 喝点什么？有新鲜果脯水。

beats.goal: State total price and demand payment

lines.en: Twenty-four zlotys total. Cash?
lines.zh: 一共二十四兹罗提。现金吗？

lines.en: Payment at register. Paying by card?
lines.zh: 在收银台结账。您刷卡吗？

beats.goal: Hand tray and call next customer

lines.en: Here you go, enjoy your meal. Next!
lines.zh: 给您，请慢用。下一位！

lines.en: Pickup behind the screen. Next, please!
lines.zh: 屏风后面取餐。下一位，请！

example.pl: Dzisiaj jest pomidorowa i żurek. Co podać?
example.en: Today we have tomato soup and sour rye soup. What can I get you?
example.zh: 今天有番茄汤和酸黑麦汤。要哪个？

example.en: Good morning! Tomato soup, please.

example.pl: A na drugie danie? Kotlet, pierogi?
example.en: And for the main course? Cutlet, pierogi?
example.zh: 那第二道主菜呢？炸肉排还是饺子？

example.en: Ruskie pierogi, please.

example.pl: Ruskie się skończyły. Są z mięsem.
example.en: Ruskie pierogi are finished. There are meat ones.
example.zh: 土豆奶酪饺子卖光了。有肉馅的。

example.en: All right, meat ones then please.
With that, compote or tea?
And compote, thank you. That is all.
example.zh: 还要果脯水，谢谢。就这些。

example.en: Twenty-four zlotys total. Cash?
example.zh: 一共二十四兹罗提。现金吗？

example.en: I'm paying by card. Thank you!
Here you go, enjoy your meal. Next!

repair.en: Louder, please! Tomato soup or sour rye soup?
repair.zh: 请大声点！番茄汤还是酸黑麦汤？

repair.pl: Pierogi z serem czy z mięsem?
repair.en: Pierogi with cheese or with meat?
repair.zh: 奶酪饺子还是肉馅饺子？

beats.goal: Ask if learner likes bigos

lines.pl: Zrobiłem bigos i sałatkę. Lubisz bigos?
lines.en: I made bigos and salad. Do you like bigos?
lines.zh: 我做了猎人炖肉和沙拉。你喜欢猎人炖肉吗？

lines.pl: Mam świeży domowy bigos. Chcesz spróbować?
lines.en: I have fresh homemade bigos. Do you want to try?
lines.zh: 我有新鲜的自制猎人炖肉。想尝尝吗？

beats.goal: Offer dish with mushrooms to learner

lines.pl: Tu są też grzyby leśne. Spróbujesz?
lines.en: There are forest mushrooms here too. Will you try?
lines.zh: 这里还有野蘑菇。你要尝尝吗？

lines.pl: Dołożyłem grzyby z lasu. Lubisz je?
lines.en: I added mushrooms from the forest. Do you like them?
lines.zh: 我加了树林里采的野蘑菇。你喜欢吗？

beats.goal: Ask if food is tasty

lines.pl: I jak sałatka? Smakuje ci kolacja?
lines.en: And how is the salad? Do you like the dinner?
lines.zh: 沙拉怎么样？晚饭合你胃口吗？

lines.en: Is the food good? I prepared everything myself.
lines.zh: 好吃吗？全是我自己亲手做的。

beats.goal: Offer second helping to learner

lines.pl: Chcesz dokładkę? Jest jeszcze dużo jedzenia.
lines.en: Do you want seconds? There is still lots of food.
lines.zh: 要再来一份吗？还有很多吃的呢。

lines.en: Shall I put a bit more salad on your plate?
lines.zh: 再给你夹点沙拉吗？

beats.goal: Say glad you enjoyed and wrap up

lines.pl: Cieszę się, że ci smakowało. Do zobaczenia!
lines.en: Glad that you enjoyed it. See you!
lines.zh: 你喜欢吃我真高兴。回头见！

lines.pl: Dzięki za miły wieczór. Do zobaczenia!
lines.en: Thanks for a lovely evening. See you!
lines.zh: 谢谢你陪伴的美好夜晚。回头见！

example.pl: Zrobiłem bigos i sałatkę. Lubisz bigos?
example.en: I made bigos and salad. Do you like bigos?
example.zh: 我做了猎人炖肉和沙拉。你喜欢猎人炖肉吗？

example.en: Yes, I really like bigos!

example.pl: Tu są też grzyby leśne. Spróbujesz?
example.en: There are forest mushrooms here too. Will you try?
example.zh: 这里还有野蘑菇。你要尝尝吗？

example.en: No thank you, I don't like mushrooms.
example.zh: 不用了谢谢，我不喜欢吃蘑菇。

example.pl: Okej, rozumiem. A sałatka ci smakuje?
example.en: Okay, I understand. And do you like the salad?
example.zh: 好的，理解。沙拉合口味吗？

example.en: This is delicious! You cook wonderfully.

example.pl: Chcesz dokładkę? Jest jeszcze dużo jedzenia.
example.en: Do you want seconds? There is still lots of food.
example.zh: 要再来一份吗？还有很多吃的呢。

example.en: Thank you, I can't eat any more. I'm full.
example.zh: 谢谢，我实在吃不下了。我饱了。

example.pl: Cieszę się, że ci smakowało. Do zobaczenia!
example.en: Glad that you enjoyed it. See you!

example.en: Thank you for dinner! See you!

repair.en: I didn't hear. Do you want seconds?
repair.zh: 我没听清。你还要再来一份吗？

repair.pl: Lubisz bigos czy wolisz samą sałatkę?
repair.en: Do you like bigos or prefer just salad?
repair.zh: 你喜欢猎人炖肉还是只想吃沙拉？

beats.goal: Ask if we have bread at home

lines.pl: Mamy chleb? Bo ja nie mam nic w lodówce.
lines.en: Do we have bread? Because I have nothing in the fridge.
lines.zh: 我们有面包吗？因为我冰箱里什么都没有。

lines.pl: Sprawdźmy listę. Mamy chleb w domu?
lines.en: Let's check the list. Do we have bread at home?
lines.zh: 我们对一下清单。家里有面包吗？

beats.goal: Ask what items need buying

lines.en: What else do we need for the party?
lines.zh: 聚会我们还需要买什么？

lines.en: What do we have to buy to eat?
lines.zh: 我们要买什么吃的？

beats.goal: Propose buying only crisps

lines.pl: Kupmy tylko czipsy i orzeszki, okej?
lines.en: Let's buy only crisps and peanuts, okay?
lines.zh: 我们就光买薯片和花生，好吗？

lines.pl: Same czipsy wystarczą na wieczór. Co myślisz?
lines.en: Just crisps are enough for the evening. What do you think?
lines.zh: 晚上光吃薯片就够了。你觉得呢？

beats.goal: Ask which drinks to take

lines.en: Fine. And what drinks are we taking?
lines.zh: 好吧。那我们拿什么饮料？

lines.en: Orange juice or still water?
lines.zh: 橙汁还是纯净水？

beats.goal: Go to checkout and wrap up

lines.en: Okay, we pay and go!
lines.zh: 好啦，买单走人！

lines.en: We have everything. Let's go to the cash desk!
lines.zh: 东西全齐了。去收银台吧！

example.pl: Mamy chleb? Bo ja nie mam nic w lodówce.
example.en: Do we have bread? Because I have nothing in the fridge.
example.zh: 我们有面包吗？因为我冰箱里什么都没有。

example.pl: Nie mamy chleba. Mamy tylko ser.
example.en: We don't have bread. We only have cheese.
example.zh: 我们没有面包。只有奶酪。

example.en: What else do we need for the party?
example.zh: 聚会我们还需要买什么？

example.en: We need bread and tomatoes.
example.zh: 我们需要面包和西红柿。

example.pl: Kupmy tylko czipsy i orzeszki, okej?
example.en: Let's buy only crisps and peanuts, okay?
example.zh: 我们就光买薯片和花生，好吗？

example.pl: Nie, to niezdrowe! Kupmy też owoce.
example.en: No, that's unhealthy! Let's buy fruit too.
example.zh: 别，那不健康！我们也买点水果吧。

example.pl: Dobra, owoce są zdrowe. A co do picia?
example.en: All right, fruit is healthy. And what to drink?
example.zh: 好吧，水果健康。喝什么呢？

example.en: Maybe apple juice and water?
Okay, we pay and go!
Super, let's go to the cash desk!

repair.en: What do you choose? Juice or cola?
repair.zh: 你选哪个？果汁还是可乐？

repair.pl: Nie słyszałam cię w sklepie. Powtórzysz?
repair.en: I didn't hear you in the store. Will you repeat?
repair.zh: 店里太吵我没听清。你能再说一遍吗？

beats.goal: Check if served drink is fine

lines.en: Is everything fine?
lines.zh: 一切都好吗？

lines.en: Here you go. Is the tea good?
lines.zh: 请用。茶合口味吗？

beats.goal: Acknowledge mistake and explain oat milk out

lines.pl: Ojej, pomyłka! Ale mleka owsianego brak.
lines.en: Oh dear, a mistake! But we're out of oat milk.
lines.zh: 哎呀，弄错了！不过今天燕麦奶用完了。

lines.pl: Przepraszam! Zrobię kawę, ale bez mleka owsianego.
lines.en: Sorry! I'll make coffee, but without oat milk.
lines.zh: 对不起！我重新做咖啡，但没有燕麦奶了。

beats.goal: Ask how learner wants replacement coffee

lines.pl: Może być zwykłe mleko czy czarna?
lines.en: Can it be regular milk or black?
lines.zh: 加普通牛奶可以吗，还是纯黑咖啡？

lines.pl: Zrobić z mlekiem krowim czy bez?
lines.en: Make it with cow's milk or without?
lines.zh: 做加牛奶的还是不加奶的？

beats.goal: Hand correct coffee with apology

lines.en: Here you go, fresh warm coffee. Sorry!
lines.zh: 给您，刚做好的热咖啡。抱歉！

lines.en: Ready now! Coffee for you.
lines.zh: 做好了！您的咖啡。

beats.goal: Apologise once more and wrap up

lines.en: Apologies once again! Have a nice day!
lines.zh: 再次抱歉！祝您愉快！

lines.pl: Bardzo dziękuję za cierpliwość. Do widzenia!
lines.en: Thank you very much for patience. Goodbye!
lines.zh: 非常感谢您的耐心包容。再见！
